_note_pa14_exempt: PA14 exemptions (Divit 2026-10-12): an unlisted capitalised token is not flagged when it is a word of the page's primary keyword or an approved secondary (case-insensitive), or the initials of a 2-3 word run in them (AP for accounts payable), or in pa14_domain_ok (domain acronyms, legal and network terms), or part of a US state name (pa14_us_states, backlog line 92). Listed pa14_brands still reject.
_note_pa15_allowed: PA15 allowed formats per page primary (Divit 2026-10-21): the format is the page's own subject, so FAQ questions may name it. Any other format still rejects.
